capabilities: Paint a timeline underlay beneath dated lines and headings
Parse single dates, date ranges and ISO dates with optional years
Drag or scroll the ruler to move through time
Jump the ruler to today with a command
Dim underlays for completed checkboxes and strikethrough text
disambiguation: Not a chronological view of your vault; it draws date bars beneath dated lines inside your notes.
extras: Manual installation only; no telemetry, no network requests, and notes are never modified. Dates stay plain text, so notes remain readable without the plugin.
motivation: The author often needs a timeline but not an entire project management system, and found that maintaining a timeline separately from notes is where it becomes work.
problem: Keeping a timeline in a separate Gantt chart or task database means maintaining it apart from the notes it describes.
summary: Lightweight plugin that draws a visual timeline under each dated line of Markdown, using inline @date syntax.
